invariants.rationale: At least one of the inputs must be non-null for the merge operation to be meaningful.
It is nonsensical to call the method if both inputs are null.
If parentObject is non-null, it is likely expected to be a JSON object for merging.
If templateObject is non-null, it is likely expected to be a JSON object for merging.
If parentObject is null, templateObject should be a valid object for a meaningful result.
